king.desc: A sovereign ruler who governs a kingdom, making authoritative decisions on matters of state, diplomacy, and law while balancing the interests of court, nobility, and subjects.

queen.desc: A sovereign ruler or royal consort who wields political influence, manages courtly affairs, and shapes diplomatic relationships through strategic alliance-building and ceremonial authority.

man.desc: An adult male navigating everyday life, making practical decisions about work, relationships, and responsibilities shaped by societal expectations of masculinity, duty, and self-reliance.

woman.desc: An adult female navigating everyday life, making practical decisions about work, relationships, and responsibilities while balancing societal expectations, personal ambition, and caregiving demands.
